candidates.title: RS.HumansOutside null list entry
candidates.finding: The loop reads element field +0x5BC. The existing predicate-failure target at RVA 0x002EFEFC increments the index and decrements the initial remaining count. Identified writers compact removals and grow the array before storing a new object.
candidates.nextStep: Audit insertion rollback, null-entry validity, object lifetime and mutation ordering; match the reported build before proposing recovery. See ghidra-humans-review-notes.md. Continue with H23 while these questions remain deferred.
uncertainties: The null entry may indicate broken ownership rather than an optional human.
The normal advance and cleanup path is mapped, but skipping an element has no established semantic contract.
Growth before initialization is observed; a surviving null slot after failure and visibility to the loop are hypotheses, not proven causes.

candidates.title: World/UI missing numeric-field owner
candidates.finding: The +0x5C child supplies a signed integer at +0x1F0, formatted as decimal text for a UI control. Selection lookup validates parent membership, not child validity. Zero would display 0 rather than blank text.
candidates.nextStep: Resolve the numeric field's meaning, child lifetime, UI callbacks and state-byte recovery before selecting any missing-value policy. See ghidra-world-review-notes.md. Continue with H05 while these questions remain deferred.
uncertainties: The earlier string-field interpretation was incorrect; neither empty text nor numeric zero is a recovered fallback contract.
The lifetime and consistency of the parent and child across control calls are unresolved.
Local string cleanup does not establish UI-state recovery; the +0x8FC flag and callback obligations need review.

candidates.title: AI cleanup missing list head
candidates.finding: AI cleanup dereferences a global head before comparing its +0x20 state; a branch reaches RVA 0x0042AE5D, whose complete semantic role is unresolved.
candidates.nextStep: Resolve the global owner's lifecycle, null-state contract and the work bypassed by the branch before choosing any continuation.
uncertainties: The car-cleanup log pointer at RVA 0x0042AE2C precedes the proposed target; the target is not proven to start car cleanup.
A null head has not been shown to mean that cleanup can safely be skipped.
